# Bekrow Development Ltd.

> Commercial general contractor in Metro Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. Specializes in commercial tenant improvements (interior fit-outs) for offices, bank branches, healthcare clinics and retail. WorkSafeBC registered and fully insured (CGL).

## Services
- Commercial tenant improvements: office, retail, bank branch and clinic fit-outs built to landlord requirements and opening dates
- General contracting for commercial and institutional projects
- Construction project management: trades, schedule and budget managed on the owner's behalf

## Strengths
- Occupied-space work: after-hours and phased construction, dust and noise control, so businesses stay open
- One point of contact from permit to closeout (permits, subtrades, inspections, deficiencies)
- Team project experience includes BMO, RBC and CIBC bank branches and healthcare facilities
- 10+ years of commercial construction experience

## Sectors
Financial services, healthcare and wellness, office, retail and hospitality, institutional and heritage.

## Service area
Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley: Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey, Coquitlam, North Vancouver, New Westminster, Delta, Langley, White Rock, Port Coquitlam, Abbotsford. Larger commercial projects considered across BC.
